meta.title: engenty — People & Agents. As One Team.
meta.description: Self-hosted, source-available workspace where your team and AI agents work in the same apps, spaces, and documents. Free to self-host. Your data. Your models.

hero.headline: People & agents.
hero.sub: Install engenty on your own machines. Your team and a crew of agents share the same spaces, apps, and documents — not a chat window bolted on the side.

pillars.title: Plugins for your own apps
pillars.body: Every module is an installable plugin. Ship contacts, tasks, or a tool only your company has — same SDK, same canvas.

pillars.title: Multi-user, multi-space
pillars.body: A space is the steady room for a client, a team, or a topic. People and agents mount the apps they need. Nothing leaks across the wall.

pillars.title: Work along your apps
pillars.body: AG-UI keeps the agent on the document, the list, the inbox — proposing edits you can keep, refine, or discard. No copy-paste round trip.

pillars.title: Own your data
pillars.body: Postgres, files, and secrets stay on infrastructure you run. Self-host with Docker and Supabase. There is no tenant we can see.

pillars.title: Choose your model
pillars.body: Point the gateway at the models you already pay for. Swap routing per job. The product does not lock you to one vendor.

spaces.title: A room for the work that lasts
spaces.body: Projects start and end. A space stays: the drive, the channels, the mounted apps, the agents who belong there. Multi-user from the first login — membership is the permission boundary.

agUi.title: The agent sits in the file
agUi.body: Drafts, enrichments, and follow-ups land on the record you are already looking at. You keep taste; the agent keeps going. Protocol: AG-UI, not a side chat that forgets the page.

stack.title: Data you hold. Models you pick.
stack.body: The open tree runs on your Postgres and object storage. Bring a Vercel AI Gateway key, or route to whatever you already operate. Phase 1 is install-it-yourself — no cloud signup.

install.title: Three commands. Your laptop.
install.body: Node 24, Docker, and a git clone. First visit creates the administrator. Copilot needs a model key; everything else comes up without one.

agUi.title: Q3 customer outreach
agUi.bodyBefore: Sequence 120 dormant accounts over 14 days. Success looks like
agUi.agentBody: Found 132 in Contacts — include the extra 12?

stack.title: Model purposes
stack.note: Postgres on your host. Files under the space prefix. No data leaves unless you send it to the model you chose.
